text: The UEBA system flagged ACM2278's (Allen Cruz Mccoy) week for review due to evidence that he browsed atypical job-search or leak-publication sites. Specifically, his visits to leak-publication sites exceeded his typical range, with a count of 3 this week compared to the usual 0 and a high of 4 in the prior 12 weeks. This is likely the most significant finding, as it deviates significantly from his normal behavior.
